definitions.explanation: The second sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly April 20 to May 20. Also the constellation Taurus. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs.

examples.japanese: {妹|いもうと}は{牡牛座|おうしざ}だ。
examples.english: My little sister is a Taurus.

examples.japanese: {牡牛座|おうしざ}の{人|ひと}はのんびりしていると{言|い}われる。
examples.english: Taurus people are said to be easygoing.

examples.japanese: {雑誌|ざっし}の{占|うらな}いで、{今月|こんげつ}の{牡牛座|おうしざ}は{恋愛|れんあい}{運|うん}がいいと{書|か}いてあった。
examples.english: The magazine horoscope said Taurus has good luck in love this month.

notes:
The zodiac sign Taurus, for people born from late April to late May. The {牡|お} prefix marks the male animal (bull).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牡牛座|おうしざ}の{人|ひと}: a person born under Taurus
- {牡牛座|おうしざ}{生|う}まれ: born a Taurus
- {牡牛座|おうしざ}の{運勢|うんせい}: the Taurus horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are common small-talk in Japan and appear in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments ({星占|ほしうらな}い).
